amniote_definition: Age at first conception.
pantheria_definition: Age when individuals are first physically capable of reproducing, defined as either physically sexually mature, age at first mating or unspecified (males and females), age at first estrus or age at first pregnancy (females only), age at spermatogenesis or age at testes descent (males only), using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals, primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Age at first conception.' is one of several operational definitions PanTHERIA pools ('age at first estrus or age at first pregnancy (females only)', 'age at first mating', 'physically sexually mature'), and PanTHERIA pools 'male, female, or sex unspecified individuals'.

amniote_definition: Age at first conception.
pantheria_definition: Age at which females give birth to their first litter (eutherians), or their young attach to teats (metatherians) or hatch out (monotremes), using non-captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Alternate counterpart: PanTHERIA 'Age at which females give birth to their first litter' = first conception + gestation; not the same event as Amniote 'Age at first conception.'

amniote_definition: Number of offspring per litter or number of eggs per clutch.
pantheria_definition: Number of offspring born per litter per female, either counted before birth, at birth or after birth, using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Number of offspring per litter or number of eggs per clutch.' vs PanTHERIA 'Number of offspring born per litter per female, either counted before birth, at birth or after birth'; for Mammalia the litter sense applies.

amniote_definition: Number of litters or clutches produced per year.
pantheria_definition: Number of litters per female per year using non-captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Number of litters or clutches produced per year.' vs PanTHERIA 'Number of litters per female per year using non-captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations'.

amniote_definition: Body mass using data from males, females, and/or unspecified adults.
pantheria_definition: Mass of adult (or age unspecified) live or freshly-killed specimens (excluding pregnant females) using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Body mass using data from males, females, and/or unspecified adults.' vs PanTHERIA 'Mass of adult (or age unspecified) ... specimens (excluding pregnant females) ...; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals'. Both pool sexes.

amniote_definition: Maximum recorded longevity for species.
pantheria_definition: Maximum adult age measured either through direct observation, capture-recapture estimates, projected from physical wear or unspecified, using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Maximum recorded longevity for species.' vs PanTHERIA 'Maximum adult age measured either through direct observation, capture-recapture estimates, projected from physical wear or unspecified'. Years -> months x 12.

amniote_definition: Length of time from conception or fertilization to birth.
pantheria_definition: Length of time of non-inactive fetal growth, using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities. Gestation was measured between specified start and end points as follows: Start points – conception, fertilization, first observed copulation, fertilization, implantation, laying, palpably pregnant, removal of pouch young, capture (except marsupials) or unspecified. End points – birth, hatching or unspecified.
note: Amniote 'Length of time from conception or fertilization to birth.' vs PanTHERIA 'Length of time of non-inactive fetal growth' measured between pooled start points ('conception, fertilization, first observed copulation, ... implantation, ... palpably pregnant, removal of pouch young, capture ... or unspecified') and end points.

amniote_definition: Age at which the species becomes dependent on food other than its mother's milk.
pantheria_definition: Age when primary nutritional dependency on the mother ends and independent foraging begins to make a major contribution to the offspring’s energy requirements, measured as either weaning/lactation length, nutritionally independent, first solid food, last observed nursing, age at first flight (bats only), age at pouch exit or length of teat Attachment (marsupials only) or unspecified definition, using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Age at which the species becomes dependent on food other than its mother's milk.' vs PanTHERIA 'Age when primary nutritional dependency on the mother ends ...' measured as any of 'weaning/lactation length, nutritionally independent, first solid food, last observed nursing, age at first flight (bats only), age at pouch exit or length of teat Attachment (marsupials only) or unspecified definition'.

amniote_definition: Weight at birth or at hatching.
pantheria_definition: Mass of live or freshly-killed specimens of infants at either a near term embryonic stage, birth, immediately after birth or up to an age of seven days after birth, using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Weight at birth or at hatching.' vs PanTHERIA 'Mass of ... infants at either a near term embryonic stage, birth, immediately after birth or up to an age of seven days after birth'.

amniote_definition: Weight at weaning.
pantheria_definition: Mass of live or freshly-killed specimens of weanlings, using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Weight at weaning.' vs PanTHERIA 'Mass of live or freshly-killed specimens of weanlings'.

amniote_definition: Egg mass.
note: Egg trait (Supplemental Table 9 taxonomic group B,R); PanTHERIA is mammal-only.

amniote_definition: Length of time between egg oviposition and hatching.
note: Egg trait (B,R); PanTHERIA gestation (9-1) ends at 'birth, hatching or unspecified' for monotremes but Amniote records incubation only for birds/reptiles.

amniote_definition: Age of the bird when it is capable of flight.
note: Bird-only trait (B).

amniote_definition: Age at death.
pantheria_definition: Maximum adult age measured either through direct observation, capture-recapture estimates, projected from physical wear or unspecified, using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Age at death.' is not defined as a maximum; PanTHERIA records the 'Maximum adult age'. Years -> months x 12.

amniote_definition: Age of sexual maturity for males.
pantheria_definition: Age when individuals are first physically capable of reproducing, defined as either physically sexually mature, age at first mating or unspecified (males and females), age at first estrus or age at first pregnancy (females only), age at spermatogenesis or age at testes descent (males only), using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals, primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Age of sexual maturity for males.' is the male subset of PanTHERIA's sex-pooled maturity age (which also pools several operational definitions).

amniote_definition: Interval between successive births or ovipositions.  This can differ from litter/clutch frequency due to seasonality.
pantheria_definition: The length of time between successive births of the same female(s) after a successful or unspecified litter using non-captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Interval between successive births or ovipositions.' vs PanTHERIA 'The length of time between successive births of the same female(s) after a successful or unspecified litter'. Years -> days x 365.25.

amniote_definition: Body mass of female adults.
pantheria_definition: Mass of adult (or age unspecified) live or freshly-killed specimens (excluding pregnant females) using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Body mass of female adults.' is the female subset of PanTHERIA's sex-pooled adult mass.

amniote_definition: Body mass of male adults.
pantheria_definition: Mass of adult (or age unspecified) live or freshly-killed specimens (excluding pregnant females) using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Body mass of male adults.' is the male subset of PanTHERIA's sex-pooled adult mass.

amniote_definition: Body mass of unspecified adults.
pantheria_definition: Mass of adult (or age unspecified) live or freshly-killed specimens (excluding pregnant females) using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Body mass of unspecified adults.' is the sex-unspecified subset of PanTHERIA's sex-pooled adult mass.

amniote_definition: Egg width.
note: Egg trait (B,R).

amniote_definition: Egg length.
note: Egg trait (B,R).

amniote_definition: Mass of the bird at the time it has developed the feathers necessary for flight.
note: Bird-only trait (B).

amniote_definition: Measure from tip of the snout to either the opening of the cloaca (Birds & Reptiles) or tail base (mammals) for male, female, and/or unspecified adults.
pantheria_definition: Total length from tip of nose to anus or base of tail of adult (or age unspecified) live, freshly-killed, or museum specimens using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Measure from tip of the snout to ... tail base (mammals) for male, female, and/or unspecified adults.' vs PanTHERIA 'Total length from tip of nose to anus or base of tail of adult (or age unspecified) ... specimens'. cm -> mm x 10.

amniote_definition: Measure from tip of the snout to the opening of the cloaca or tail base for male adults.
pantheria_definition: Total length from tip of nose to anus or base of tail of adult (or age unspecified) live, freshly-killed, or museum specimens using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote male-only snout-to-tail-base length vs PanTHERIA sex-pooled head-body length. cm -> mm x 10.

amniote_definition: Measure from tip of the snout to the opening of the cloaca or tail base for female adults.
pantheria_definition: Total length from tip of nose to anus or base of tail of adult (or age unspecified) live, freshly-killed, or museum specimens using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote female-only snout-to-tail-base length vs PanTHERIA sex-pooled head-body length. cm -> mm x 10.

amniote_definition: Measure from tip of the snout to the opening of the cloaca or tail base at the time of hatching for male, female, and/or unspecified newborn animals.
pantheria_definition: Total length from tip of nose to anus or base of tail of live, freshly-killed, or museum specimens of infants at either a near term embryonic stage, birth, immediately after birth or up to an age of seven days after birth, using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'at the time of hatching' (birth) vs PanTHERIA 'infants at either a near term embryonic stage, birth, immediately after birth or up to an age of seven days after birth'. cm -> mm x 10.

amniote_definition: Measure from tip of the snout to the opening of the cloaca or tail base at the time of maturity for females.
note: PanTHERIA has no length-at-maturity variable (its length variables are adult, neonate and weaning head-body length).

amniote_definition: Body mass at the time of maturity for females.
note: PanTHERIA has no mass-at-maturity variable (adult, neonate, weaning body mass only).

amniote_definition: Measure from tip of the snout to the opening of the cloaca or tail base for unspecified adults.
pantheria_definition: Total length from tip of nose to anus or base of tail of adult (or age unspecified) live, freshly-killed, or museum specimens using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals; primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote sex-unspecified snout-to-tail-base length vs PanTHERIA sex-pooled head-body length. cm -> mm x 10.

amniote_definition: Age at sexual maturity for unspecified adults.
pantheria_definition: Age when individuals are first physically capable of reproducing, defined as either physically sexually mature, age at first mating or unspecified (males and females), age at first estrus or age at first pregnancy (females only), age at spermatogenesis or age at testes descent (males only), using captive, wild, provisioned, or unspecified populations; male, female, or sex unspecified individuals, primary, secondary, or extrapolated sources; all measures of central tendency; in all localities.
note: Amniote 'Age at sexual maturity for unspecified adults.' is the sex-unspecified subset of PanTHERIA's sex-pooled maturity age.
